scope: Semantic landmark/frame definitions; fitting deliberately deferred to Phase 6

conventions.global_reporting_basis: right-handed X anterior, Y superior, Z anatomical right
conventions.segment_origins: Segment reference origin is not automatically the joint centre.
conventions.rotations: Use region-specific ISB JCS sequences when available; store full relative quaternion/translation. Never treat all joints as XYZ Euler hinges.
conventions.bilateral: Mirror geometry, then reconstruct a positive-determinant basis; anatomical positive motion signs are side-aware. Do not negate one matrix axis and retain an improper basis.
conventions.project_adapter: Current header says project_x_right_y_up_z_forward. Anatomical anterior sign and physical left/right orientation must be measured from the local character. Axis permutation alone can have determinant -1. No adapter accepted before Phase 6.
conventions.extension_policy: Full individual-bone frames outside ISB coverage are project definitions, explicitly tagged; they are not attributed as published ISB standards.
conventions.degeneracy: Coincident or collinear landmarks and non-finite vectors fail; never silently fall back to arbitrary world axes.

cranial_base.axis_recipe: Frankfort plane; anterior from nasion; right from poria

mandible.axis_recipe: Bicondylar transverse; mandibular body anterior hint

upper_cervical.axis_recipe: Dens superior; atlas arches anterior; condyles transverse

vertebra.axis_recipe: Endplates superior; body-minus-spinous anterior; orthogonal completion

thorax.axis_recipe: Superior between paired midpoint levels; anterior normal to sagittal landmark plane

rib.axis_recipe: Head-tubercle functional axis when present; rib plane from angle and anterior end

sternal_components.axis_recipe: Sternal midline superior; anterior surface normal

scapula.axis_recipe: TS-to-AA transverse; AA-TS-AI plane normal anterior

humerus.axis_recipe: Epicondylar midpoint-to-GH superior; epicondylar plane normal anterior

ulna.axis_recipe: US-to-epicondylar midpoint proximal; landmark-plane anterior normal

radius.axis_recipe: RS-to-EL proximal; styloid-plane normal anterior; neutral elbow posture documented

carpal.axis_recipe: Proximal/distal surfaces define longitudinal; dorsal-volar hint defines roll

metacarpal.axis_recipe: Head-to-base proximal; dorsal landmark defines roll

thumb_cmc.axis_recipe: Two fitted saddle axes; coupled axial rotation; do not copy finger hinges

pelvis.origin_recipe: hip centre per side; pelvis origin separately retained
pelvis.axis_recipe: ASIS transverse; pelvic plane anterior; orthogonal superior

sacrum.axis_recipe: Sacral base-apex superior; posterior sacral surface orientation

coccyx.axis_recipe: Component centroid chain; posterior hint for roll

femur.axis_recipe: Epicondylar midpoint-to-hip proximal; transverse projected epicondyles

tibia.axis_recipe: Malleolar transverse; tibial torsional-plane anterior normal

patella.axis_recipe: Base-apex longitudinal; posterior facets define orientation

fibula.axis_recipe: Head-to-LM long axis; tibial-contact direction sets roll

talus.axis_recipe: Dome geometry for talocrural axis; separate oblique facet-based subtalar axis

calcaneus.axis_recipe: Heel-to-anterior long direction; plantar reference normal

midfoot.axis_recipe: Contact geometry plus plantar plane; no single universal midfoot hinge

metatarsal.axis_recipe: Base-head long direction; plantar hint; transverse head reference

toe_phalanx.axis_recipe: Long direction plus paired condylar transverse; hallux independent

hyoid.axis_recipe: Bilateral greater-horn transverse; body anterior hint

ossicle.axis_recipe: Articular patches and footplate normal; no exercise rotation channels
